scripts.api: cd backend-laravel && set PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS=8&& php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000
scripts.test:api:coverage: cd backend-laravel && php -d zend_extension=xdebug -d xdebug.mode=coverage vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text
scripts.espelho:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.espelho.yml stop nginx php redis
scripts.espelho:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.espelho.yml logs -f nginx php
